{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute mean of biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Confirm no missing values
missing_count = df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum()

# Print both
print(f'Mean biomarker_final: {mean_biomarker_final}')
print(f'Missing values in biomarker_final: {missing_count}')"}
